name: AI Order Intake - Slack Review Actions

parameters.content:
## Review links
Approve / Reject buttons in Slack open this webhook. Links are HMAC-signed and expire after 24 hours.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: ((s) => `:white_check_mark: ${s.id} approved and dispatched on ${s.route.id} (${s.route.driver.name}), pickup ETA ${s.route.pickup_eta}`)($('TMS: Dispatch Approved').item.json) }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ text: `:x: ${$json.id} was rejected and cancelled in the TMS` }) }}
